{{Youmay|the test used in the Je'daii Order|the [[Initiate Trials/Legends|Initiate Trials]] of the later Jedi Order}}
The '''Padawan Trial''' was a test that [[Je'daii initiate]]s of the [[Je'daii Order]] were given as prerequisite in order to progress to the level of [[Padawan (Je'daii)|Padawan]].<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Padawan Trial was first mentioned in the [[2016]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Nexus of Power]]''. The [[Great Journey]] was misidentified as the "Padawan Trial" in the sourcebook.<ref name="NoP" />
